notes.title: So Many Zombies VR Notes
notes.notes:
[b]This video contains some pointers for playing SMZ in VR:[/b]
https://youtu.be/oQ8ngAujWxE

[u][b]Some Key Points In VR[/b]:[/u]

[i]Important:[/i] While messages are displayed, time dilation is in effect to slow the game down and give you time to read.

[i]Important:[/i] After starting the game, be sure to recenter your view by holding the menu button. (eg On Quest press and hold right menu button). If your orientation is off, you may not see the on screen menu.

[b]HERO CONTROLS[/b]
[i]Hero Dual Stick Controls:[/i] Move your character with the Left Stick, Aim and shoot your Weapon with Right Stick.

[b]CAMERA CONTROLS[/b]
[i]Snap To Character:[/i] At any time, you can snap the camera behind the character by pressing and releasing X. This enables you to Teleport to your hero as you move around the world.

[i]PinGrip Camera Move:[/i] You can also move the camera around the world using PinGrab. Pin the world to your hand with Right or Left Grip, then move your hand to move the world around you.

[i]PinRotate: [/i]After pinning with one hand, you can grip the other hand to rotate the world around the pinned point.

notes.title: 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you to all of our players and their feedback since our launch last night. 
Below are a few initial balancing patches.

[i][list]
[*] Adjusted most powerup costs to better match each powerup's strength
[*] Moderately nerfed Laser, Flamethrower, Sentry Turret, Rocket, Shield, and Speed powerups to scale across gameplay
[*] Moderately buffed most weapon upgrades to better match each powerup's strengths
[*] Capped each powerup's max level to 10
[*] Fixed Humans attracting to Deadmeat
[*] Fixed unintentional reroll count
[/list][/i]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility Information
notes.notes:
While we are awaiting official review from Valve, we have done extensive testing on Steam Deck during our development.

Steam Deck support includes:
[list]
[i][*] Automatic settings adjustments on game launch
[*] Steam Deck settings button in the menu settings
[*] Performance adjustments to keep Steam Deck at a higher average smooth frame rate[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0 Launch Out Now!
notes.notes:
So Many Zombies leverages your GPU to render crazy numbers of 3D animated zombies! Survive as long as you can against the endless zombie horde with your high-powered arsenal.

Thank you to all of our demo players from Next Fest in October. We are happy to finally release the game and look forward to growing the game with our community in the forums.
